The '''YT-1930''' was a moderately successful [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that was released by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

The design of the YT-1930 was a variant on the successful [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], but placed the cockpit along the center line of the ship, and added two wedge-shaped cargo areas at the rear to double the cargo capacity of its predecessor. Most came with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turret. Though some considered it to be the pinnacle of the YT-series, the YT-1930 never gained the following of the older freighter design had.
